time.description: Event timestamp in milliseconds since Unix epoch

authDetails.description: Details about the admin who performed the action

resourceType.description: Type of resource affected (e.g. USER, CLIENT, REALM, ROLE, GROUP, …)

resourcePath.description: Path to the affected resource within the realm (e.g. users/uuid)

representation.description: JSON representation of the resource state after the operation (only when include-representation is enabled)

error.description: Error code when the event represents a failure (null on success)

AuthDetails.title: AuthDetails
AuthDetails.description: Identity of the admin who triggered the event

realmId.description: Realm ID of the authenticating admin

realmName.description: Realm name of the authenticating admin

clientId.description: Client ID used by the admin (e.g. security-admin-console)

userId.description: Keycloak user ID of the admin (UUID)

ipAddress.description: IP address of the admin client
